en.body:
The air is buzzing with anticipation for **Exiles**, the Starz spin-off series that will continue the story of **Daniel 'Hondo' Harrelson**. While details about the new show are still emerging, one thing is clear: Hondo built deep connections during his time with the **S.W.A.T.** team in Los Angeles. It's only natural for fans to hope that some of these cherished characters will make guest appearances, adding layers of familiar chemistry and shared history to the new narrative.

The original **S.W.A.T.** series, which concluded its run, left viewers invested in the dynamics of Hondo's unit. The possibility of seeing these characters interact with Hondo in a new context on **Exiles** presents an exciting prospect for long-time fans. These aren't just colleagues; they're a family forged in the crucible of high-stakes police work. Their presence could offer both comfort and compelling new storylines, exploring how their relationships have evolved outside the direct confines of the original show.

## The Appeal of Familiar Faces

The number five itself carries a certain resonance, often symbolizing balance and humanity across various cultures. In the context of **S.W.A.T.**, five key characters, beyond Hondo, represent the core of the team's strength and camaraderie. Their potential return isn't just about fan service; it's about enriching the world of **Exiles** with established emotional stakes. Imagine the wisdom **Sergeant Momolu 'Street' Kane** might impart, or the tactical brilliance **Jim Street** himself could bring to a new challenge. The dynamic between **Victor Tan** and Hondo always provided a unique blend of respect and banter, and seeing that play out again would be a treat. Even characters like **Christina 'Chris' Alonso** or **Jessica Cortez** could offer invaluable perspectives, demonstrating the lasting impact of their shared experiences.

## What Fans Are Hoping For

Fans have taken to social media and forums to voice their desires for specific guest appearances. The overarching sentiment is a longing to see the enduring bonds of the **S.W.A.T.** team showcased once more. These characters are more than just actors on a screen; they are a significant part of many viewers' television landscape. Their potential return in **Exiles** is seen as a bridge between beloved past and an anticipated future, offering a sense of continuity and closure for the original series while building excitement for the new one. The stakes for the fans are emotional – they want to see their heroes, their friends, continue to thrive, even in a new setting.

## What's Next

While **Exiles** is slated for a 2026 release, specific casting news and plot details are still under wraps. We Cult News will continue to monitor all announcements regarding **Exiles** and potential **S.W.A.T.** cast crossovers. Until then, rewatching favorite **S.W.A.T.** moments might be the best way to prepare for Hondo's next chapter.

content_raw: Hondo still has plenty of friends in Los Angeles, and we're hoping to see a few more of them show up on his Starz spin-off.
